data.name: Операция "Гость"
data.detailed_description:
Get ready for an exciting adventure set against the backdrop of what seems to be an ordinary Russian small town at the end of the 1990s. You are a young student returning home for the holidays, seeking peace and quiet. But your expectations shatter when a terrorist group invades the area, prompting a counter-terrorism operation. What begins as a local conflict quickly escalates into something much more sinister.

You find yourself in the center of a conspiracy, confronting soldiers, gangsters, ruthless terrorists, and supernatural forces. As the plot develops, the boundaries between reality and the supernatural become dangerously blurred, revealing shocking secrets from the past and present.

Will you be able to save your home and uncover the dark secrets it hides?

KEY FEATURES

  • Original storyline

  • An open-world location covering 16 km², including the main character’s town and the surrounding villages

  • Travel around the location on foot, skateboard, vehicle, or watercraft

  • Secrets and Easter eggs

  • A storyline mission system in the style of GTA, where the main character completes tasks for local residents

  • Side activities

  • Combat against various enemies using hand-to-hand combat and firearms

  • The ability to use substances that alter consciousness

data.short_description: Operation Guest is an action-adventure game set in Russia in the late 1990s. Explore an open world, complete tasks from local residents, battle enemies, find secrets and uncover a terrifying conspiracy as you embark on an exciting journey.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel или AMD, 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 730
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

  • Processor: Quad-core Intel или AMD, 3.6 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
